layouts.title: Occupancy and assumed admission capacity are independent checks
layouts.desc: Fleet Controller independently places replicas r7 to r9 on Node C and receives observed state. Each node has 96 active slots and an assumed admission capacity of 12 req/s. Nine replicas provide 288 slots and 36 req/s.
